checks: Only buildPluginReferenceCatalog and findPluginReferenceCatalogEntry are exported, with exact supplied parameter and return types.
The only source import is the exact type-only @knorvia/contracts set PluginMetadata, PluginReferenceCatalog, PluginReferenceCatalogEntry.
Map creates a fresh catalog plugins array in input order and an entry for every input including disabled inputs.
Enabled conflicts filter truthy-enabled exact-name peers, remove all exact self IDs, preserve duplicate other IDs, and default-sort; disabled conflicts are fresh empty arrays.
Entry own field order is pluginId, name, marketplace, enabled, conflictingPluginIds, skillQualifiedNames, mcpServerNames, subagentNames, rootPath.
Skills and agents use separate invocation-local sets across all corresponding component groups; trim names, omit empty names, prefix original plugin.name plus colon, deduplicate, and default-sort.
Other component group kinds are ignored; source arrays, items and names are never mutated.
MCP names are copied and default-sorted with duplicates and disabled supplied names preserved.
IDs, names, marketplaces, enabled and rootPath values are copied unchanged.
Find returns first exact-ID entry by reference, returns undefined when catalog or match is absent, and performs no cloning or fallback.
There are no catches, schema repair, persistence, shared mutable state, runtime imports or authority operations; native errors propagate.
Source has 60 lines, below the strict 400-line ceiling.
